description: Rejected controlled continuation of the native unified search-aware MPE/WDL preflight. It passed the exported model gate, but corrected native-32 engine-search validation still loses badly to the reference. The earlier harsher gate result is invalid because it used an engine build that could silently take the legacy loader path for this 32-bucket net.

metadata.parent_result: model gate rerun: pt=nn exact, top1 499/1409, top3 898/1409, sum_gap 151483, median gap 19cp, worst 800cp. Net diff changed 2.81M/25.20M exported values, including 2.81M input weights and 1201 L1 weights. Quant scan showed exported input movement 11.161% and L1 movement 3.665%. This is export-visible but still below the preflight top1 threshold.
metadata.hypothesis: The mixed objective is not dead: it improved target move-choice substantially and selected the final epoch. A lower-LR continuation from the exported checkpoint, using the next 100k broad rows, tests whether it can cross the model gate without another scalar-only or local-repair loop.
metadata.baseline_model_gate: Parent exported model: top1 499/1409, top3 898/1409. Original native init model: top1 337/1409, top3 594/1409.
metadata.baseline_reference_gate: Current reference engine at 300k nodes on unified targets: top1 761/1409, top3 1130/1409; mate_like top1 108/235, non_mate top1 653/1174.
metadata.result: validate_search_targets_model passed with pt=nn exact, top1 647/1409, top3 1065/1409. Static on the next 100k broad rows improved versus parent (mae 129.63 -> 111.47, sign 76.81% -> 80.40%). Net-diff versus parent changed 1.725M/25.200M exported values, including 1.724M input weights and 290 L1 weights. Quant-scan versus parent showed exported input movement 6.853% and L1 movement 0.885%. The original 300k engine-search gate was invalid because it used an engine build that did not support native 32-bucket loads and could fall back to the legacy loader. Corrected native-32 validation with --require-native-net-load still rejects it: 1k nodes top1 338/1409, top3 632/1409, 177 candidate-better vs 855 reference-better, capped -94698; 10k nodes top1 446/1409, top3 765/1409, 187 vs 728, capped -66065; 300k nodes top1 560/1409, top3 914/1409, 207 vs 553, capped -35908, median_nonzero_diff_cp -28, worst_regression_cp -32000.
metadata.decision: No SPRT. Do not continue this run or launch another same-objective continuation. The corrected model-vs-engine join shows that when 300k search follows the exported model move, the candidate is neutral/slightly positive versus reference (60 candidate-better vs 57 reference-better, capped +618). The loss is concentrated in positions where search overrides the model (147 vs 496, capped -36526), especially the 303 positions where the model has the target as top1 but engine search chooses another move (28 vs 199, capped -17453). A forced-searchmoves probe on those 303 positions confirms the model move scores worse than normal search in 201 positions, equal in 27, better in 75; median forced-minus-normal score is -45cp. Next work must target searched continuation stability after the desired root move, not another direct child-eval-only model gate.

validation.preflight_only: Do not run SPRT from this config.
validation.engine_gate: Rejected by corrected native-32 300k-node search gate on the unified search-aware corpus.
validation.hard_stop: Closed. Do not continue the mixed-objective continuation path without a model-vs-engine mismatch diagnosis and a new objective hypothesis.
